owner_override.description: The active authenticated owner goal explicitly makes Voice/Albanian/English part of this source convergence. This supersedes frozen-roadmap decision D10 for this candidate only; it does not authorize promotion or live activation.

central_conflict_intent.fabric.loop: One Catalog and MissionLoop. Preserve browser inspect/owner-grant enforcement, Git/GitHub reconciliation-only STOP allowance, workflow.run registration, nested-receipt verification, and all pre-existing capabilities.
central_conflict_intent.fabric.executors: One ExecutorContext and handler map carrying browser authorization/reauth, GitHub read/write transports, workflow nesting, Windows/general-work context, and existing runtime fields. No permissive fallback when configuration is absent.
central_conflict_intent.fabric.adapter: Preserve canonical context construction and default-off GitHub dispatch settings; later add browser owner-config injection at this existing seam, never from mission payload authority.
central_conflict_intent.fabric.model_and_init: Preserve Lane 4 failure policies and recipe exports without replacing canonical action/effect models.
central_conflict_intent.command_center: Command Center remains a projection and canonical owner-control transport; voice text, UI preferences, and toast delivery adapt to existing OwnerControlService and decision queue.
central_conflict_intent.runtime.worker_loop: Preserve one worker/recovery loop; campaign capacity reconciliation is an additive startup/recovery pass, not a scheduler.
central_conflict_intent.executive: Preserve the existing Continuous Executive and campaign authority; child workflow dispatch must use canonical missions/Fabric and retain original objective lineage.
